description: List, add, remove, prune or clear accepted findings in the project baseline. Adding requires a finding ID and a reason; an acceptance can carry a ticket, an expiry date, a disposition, and the resolved finding's path and rule scope. dryRun previews the suppression impact without writing. Batch validates up to 50 add/remove items before writing, reports per-item misses and defaults to dryRun=true. Removed or expired entries stop suppressing on the next scan.

action.description: Baseline operation. Defaults to list. prune and batch default to dryRun=true.

confirm.description: Required for clear: confirm that the baseline is emptied.

disposition.description: Why the finding is accepted. A remediated finding must be removed from the baseline instead.

dryRun.description: Preview the change without writing. Defaults to true for batch and prune, false for add and remove.

expires.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). The entry stops suppressing the next day; a past date is rejected on add.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix. Required for add and remove.

items.description: Batch of add/remove items (max 50). Requires action=batch. A write requires dryRun=false; any invalid item leaves the baseline untouched.

expires.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); a past date is rejected on add.

findingId.description: Finding ID, fingerprint or unique prefix.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted. Required for add.

ticket.description: Ticket or issue reference (control characters stripped, 128 characters max).

limit.description: List: findings per page (default 50, capped at 500).

offset.description: List: number of findings to skip. Defaults to 0.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted. Required for add.

scanId.description: Scan to resolve findings in and to preview the suppression impact. Defaults to the most recent scan.

ticket.description: Ticket or issue reference stored with the acceptance. Control characters are stripped and the value is capped at 128 characters.
